notes.drawing: One text block for text-wrap, text-wrap-slash and text-overflow: rows at y 64, 128 and 192 (text-align-left's spacing is 40; 64 leaves room for the curl), lines from x 40, the same short bottom line (40→72) and the same 24-unit arrowheads. The top line runs to 208; the middle line runs to 176 and curls (radius 32, outer edge on 208, so the block keeps one right edge) back along the bottom row to an arrowhead at x 120.
notes.fill: As text-align-left-fill: a filled rounded square with the glyph cut out in white (rows 80 / 128 / 176, curl radius 24, arrowhead arms 20).
notes.duotone: Tints the text block: under the top line, down the right edge and round the curl.
